svg.title: Model scores across the three P3D-Bench tasks
svg.desc: Image/Assembly source: https://spatiaos.github.io/projects/P3D-Bench/ (snapshot 2026-09-15T23:01:23+08:00). Text uses the published fixed-100 website results; Image and Assembly average geometry, aesthetics and semantic Judge axes. Task order: Assembly-3D, Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D. Bar heights use source Score values; labels round to one decimal.
